updates.how: A new front brake duct design is introduced at this event, resulting in improved flow conditioning and gain in aerodynamic load.
The floor board and various elements of the floor furniture have been revised, resulting in an improvement of flow physics and gain in overall efficiency.
Inboard of the rear rims and as part of the rear wheel bodywork assembly, the cascade wings have been revised by changing the number of elements to improve the load characteristics and stability.

updates.change: Increased cooling inlet and outlet sections, updated lower deflector, re-optimized rearward winglet cluster
updates.how: This update has 2 main objectives: corner cooling via increased inlet/outlet sections, and local loading via lower deflector redesign and winglet loading optimisation, maximizing aerodynamic efficiency

updates.change: A new front wing geometry with updated profiles and endplate surfaces.
updates.how: An updated front wing assembly has been developed, which aims to generate an increase in local loading combined with an improved flow field interaction with downstream components.
The combined updates optimise the flow around the rear floor, allowing it to generate more load and provide increased performance.
In combination with the above, the new deflector targets an improvement in local flow conditioning and improved floor performance.

The rear wing profiles were comprehensively revised, with particular emphasis placed on the optimisation of flap geometry, leading to an increase in aerodynamic load while preserving a high level of overall efficiency across the operating range.

updates.change: Rear Wing Endplate with external protrusions
updates.how: The Rear Wing Endplates were refined through the introduction of localized protrusions aimed at promoting upwash, contributing to the increase of load of this assembly.
